findings.text: The smoothed score was 180,453 against a threshold of 52,942 (+240.9%).

findings.rule: fires when the alert bin's raw score is below the previous smoothed score (smoothed score falling)
findings.text: The alert bin's own raw score (197,231) was above the smoothed score carried from 00:35 (176,258), so the smoothed score was still rising at the alert, and the smoothing state carried from earlier bins accounts for 78.14% of the current smoothed score.
findings.detail: Smoothing rule: smoothed = 0.20 × raw + 0.80 × previous smoothed; restarts after a gap over 10 min. The share from earlier bins is one minus the alert bin's own term. This shows how the smoothing works; it does not show which earlier bins carried the evidence or that a condition persisted, and one large raw score can by itself produce several smoothed hits.

findings.rule: per displayed group: percentile at window start and at the alert, largest one-bin rise, first bin above every calibration bin; no thresholds
findings.text: Calibration percentile of each group's smoothed contribution: tp2 1.34 at 23:45 and 100 at 00:40, largest one-bin rise 1.34 to 100 between 00:15 and 00:30 across a data gap, first above every calibration bin at 00:30; dv_pressure 0.00 at 23:45 and 90.70 at 00:40, largest one-bin rise 0.00 to 90.37 between 00:15 and 00:30 across a data gap, never above every calibration bin in this window. These rank the detector's smoothed evidence; they do not show when a fault began.

findings.rule: fires when two or more tested single-group repairs clear the alert at the alert bin
findings.text: Only the tp2 repair removes the alert at 00:40 (repaired smoothed score 10,874 against the 52,942 threshold); repairs of dv_pressure, motor_current, h1 and pressure_relationships leave it in place. This tests the detector, not the machine.
findings.detail: Tested groups, each replaced on its own over 23:45 to 00:40 (10 bins): tp2, dv_pressure, motor_current, h1 and pressure_relationships, the groups with the largest smoothed contributions. Combinations and other groups were not tested, and clearing is checked at 00:40 only. Re-projection changes other groups' residuals too, so a repair is not the same as removing the group's own contribution. The smoothed score falls by a multiple of the group's own smoothed contribution: tp2 1.00×. The repair does not edit the smoothing state from before the window; its share of the 00:40 smoothed score: none, because smoothing restarts at 00:30 inside the window.

findings.rule: fires when a clearing repair leaves the smoothed score at or above the threshold
findings.text: Every repair that clears this alert also brings the smoothed score below the threshold.

findings.text: At the alert bin, tp2__mean (8.82) was above its training interquartile range (-0.0121 to -0.00853); tp2__min (7.62) was above its training interquartile range (-0.016 to -0.012); tp2__max (9.1) was above its training interquartile range (-0.01 to -0.006). Only these features are exported for the alert bin; units are not loaded, and a value inside the range is not shown to be normal.

findings.text: Leakage and higher downstream demand both raise total outflow (total outflow = demand + leakage). Without an independent demand measurement this data cannot tell them apart.
